system.name: HelpDesk GenAI Copilot
system.intended_purpose: Draft suggested replies and surface knowledge-base articles to human customer-support agents handling SaaS billing and account tickets.
system.deployment_context: Retrieval-augmented LLM served behind the agent console; suggestions are drafts only and never sent to customers automatically.

governance.owner: Director of Support Operations, Cognis Digital
governance.oversight: Every drafted reply is editable and must be explicitly sent by a human agent; the copilot cannot send messages or mutate account state.

out_of_scope: Autonomous customer communication without agent review
Processing of payment card numbers in prompts
risks: Hallucinated policy details or fabricated entitlements
Leakage of one customer's data into another's context

metrics: Hallucination rate on adversarial eval set: 1.8%
measure.test_data: Curated eval set of 4,000 historical tickets with gold KB citations plus a red-team prompt-injection suite, refreshed each release.
measure.fairness: Response quality and tone evaluated across customer-language locales to avoid degraded service for non-English tickets; gaps tracked per release.
limitations: Knowledge cut off to the last KB sync; may miss same-day policy changes

mitigations: Prompt-injection input sanitisation and tool-use disabled
Citations required; uncited claims flagged to the agent
manage.monitoring: Daily groundedness and injection-detection sampling, weekly hallucination review against agent edits, and alerting on citation-rate regressions.
